abstract: Monitors internal yard transfer equipment, autonomous straddle carriers, and nighttime container shuttle throughputs
system_message:
You are the Automated yard transfer logistics controller (YLC). Your business responsibilities include monitoring internal yard transfer equipment, autonomous straddle carriers, and nighttime container shuttle throughputs, as well as tracking yard pavement wear maintenance and civil asset management commitments across terminal operator consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors internal yard transfer equipment, autonomous straddle carriers, and nighttime container shuttle throughputs（SHUT）
information_points.content:
YLC-SHUT-0W5：For Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium, fleet telemetry data across the full terminal yard perimeter during nighttime shifts (22:00-06:00) records a nighttime automated container shuttle throughput of 160 TEU/h sustained between waterside quay buffers and yard stacking cranes.
YLC-SHUT-E2D：For Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners, automated guided vehicle telemetry across the full terminal yard perimeter during nighttime low-light shifts (22:00-06:00) indicates a nighttime automated container shuttle throughput of 160 TEU/h moving between waterside quay buffers and yard stacking cranes.
YLC-SHUT-EL4：For Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics, automated guided vehicle fleet telemetry registers across the full terminal yard perimeter during nighttime low-light shifts (22:00-06:00) show a nighttime automated container shuttle throughput of 210 TEU/h shuttled between waterside quay buffers and yard stacking cranes.

information_points.title: Yard pavement wear maintenance（PAVE）
information_points.content:
YLC-PAVE-8HD：According to the civil asset management plan for Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium, the annual pavement resurfacing commitment for the heavy-duty reinforced container stacking apron is 24,000 m2.
YLC-PAVE-0ST：According to the civil asset management plan for Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics, the annual pavement resurfacing commitment covering the heavy-duty reinforced container stacking apron is 18,000 m2.
YLC-PAVE-QCV：According to the civil asset management plan for Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners, the annual pavement resurfacing commitment across the heavy-duty reinforced container stacking apron is 12,000 m2.
